title: FORGE Pakistani food and portion starting references
macroBasis: grams of protein, carbohydrate and fat, and kcal, per 100 g edible prepared food
important: A bounded food reference, not every Pakistani food or a restaurant/manufacturer database. Recipe entries are editable ingredient-based starting estimates, not measured national food composition values. Always show assumptions and require final confirmation. Unknown names and brands need clarification; do not silently substitute a generic food.

clarifications.question: Do you mean chewing gum, a packet snack or something else? Please choose the product or give its label/weight.

What brand and packet/piece weight? Use the label, or confirm a clearly stated generic reference.

Was the chapli kebab beef or chicken, and approximately how big?
Was this beef or chicken haleem? The oil, grains and portion also vary.
